outcome: BG follow-up (3 hours and 24 hours after birth)
cohort: The study included 117 singleton newborns of 37 weeks gestational age or older who were delivered by planned elective Cesarean section.
finding: Antenatal dexamethasone was associated with a decrease in umbilical cord blood glucose and blood glucose three hours after birth, but no significant difference in blood glucose at 24 hours, C-peptide, birth weight, or neonatal nursery admission.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on term neonates delivered by elective Cesarean section, therefore, all findings are related to this mode of birth.
